lead: Justin Trudeau is a widely followed Canadian minister, born on 25 December 1971 in Ottawa.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has 3 credited works on public record and has held the office of Leader of the Liberal Party of Canada and Prime Minister of Canada.

sections.heading: Justin Trudeau — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Justin Trudeau was born on 25 December 1971 in Ottawa, and holds Canadian nationality. He was given the name Justin Pierre James Trudeau at birth and is publicly known as Justin Trudeau.
Public records name his father, Pierre Trudeau and his mother, Margaret Trudeau. He is a sibling of Michel Trudeau, Alexandre Trudeau and Sarah Coyne.
He received his education at McGill University, University of British Columbia and Collège Jean-de-Brébeuf.
He is recorded as speaking English and French.

sections.heading: Justin Trudeau — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists minister, lawyer, jurist, politician, actor and teacher as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Leader of the Liberal Party of Canada (2013–2025), Prime Minister of Canada (2015–2025), Minister of Intergovernmental Affairs (2015–2018), member of the House of Commons of Canada (2008–2011), member of the House of Commons of Canada (2011–2015) and member of the House of Commons of Canada (2015–2019). He is affiliated with Liberal Party of Canada.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2016 and World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2018.
